dict.string: Camera access allows users to capture and share real-time weather conditions, which can be useful for reporting situations during emergencies.
Contacts access allows users to quickly select and share weather updates or contact important people during emergencies, including reaching out for assistance such as NDRF support when needed.

We use your location to provide accurate real-time weather updates, forecasts, and location-based weather news, and to help users identify nearby emergency support such as NDRF teams during severe weather conditions.
Microphone access is used for voice-based weather search, enabling quick access to information during normal and emergency situations.
Photo library access allows users to upload images related to weather conditions, including sharing visuals during emergency situations.
